assets.name: riftblade
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: inventory sprite for a classic Tibia 7.6 pixel-art game, to be reduced to 32x32. One unique Riftblade sword, a dark obsidian one-handed longsword with a split silver blade containing a vivid violet-magenta dimensional fissure, small violet crystal in the crossguard and wrapped dark leather grip. A legible compact silhouette. Blade tip toward upper right, handle toward lower left. Style: authentic old-school hand-placed pixel art, crisp chunky visible square pixels as if drawn on a 32 by 32 logical grid then nearest-neighbor enlarged. Restrained 16-color palette, dark outline, upper-left highlights, sharp edges, no antialiasing, no blur. Single isolated weapon fills 85% of square canvas. Genuine transparent background. No text, no labels, no frame, no shadow, no pedestal, no particles outside the weapon, no glow haze, no extra items.
